title: Fiverr services
one_liner: Sell a service like editing, thumbnails or UGC videos as a Fiverr gig.
pay: You set the price; Fiverr keeps 20% of each order (incl. tips). Money clears after 14 days (7 for Top Rated/Pro). Check Fiverr's page.
steps: Pick one service you can deliver well.
Write a title with buyers' words.
Price the basic package to win first reviews.
catch: New gigs get few orders until reviews come in, and the 20% fee comes off every order.
sources: Wise: how to get paid on Fiverr

match.first_step: Write your gig title as 'I will [service] for [who]'.
